info.title: Hospital Appointment & Patient Management API
info.description:
Departments, doctors, patients, appointment booking without overlaps, the appointment lifecycle, medical records and reports. Day 09 adds doctor working hours and leave, free-slot generation, a status-change audit trail, a missed-appointment job and booking/cancellation notifications.

Errors always use the same JSON: timestamp, status, errorCode, message, path.
